categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Internet & Smart Hardware and Security. Internet & Smart Hardware includes internet advertising and services, smart hardware sales, internet value-added services, and gaming. The Security segment focuses on enterprise and government cybersecurity products, services, and integrated solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include artificial intelligence (AI) with a focus on large language models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), and collaboration-of-experts (CoE) architecture. The company develops proprietary AI models such as the 360 Zhinao series and integrates AI with cybersecurity through its 360 Security Large Model. Production methods emphasize cloud computing, big data analytics, and SaaS delivery models for security services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include individual internet users, enterprises, government agencies, and public institutions. The company serves sectors such as finance, education, energy, defense, transportation, and city governments. Its products target both consumer (C-end) and business/government (B/G-end) markets, with a strong focus on digital security and AI-powered internet services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant activities in major cities including Beijing, Tianjin, and other large urban centers. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments, with some business and assets in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, the British Virgin Islands, and the United States. Overseas revenue and assets constitute a smaller portion of the total.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital security and internet services supply chain. It develops proprietary AI models and software products, provides cloud-based security services (SaaS), and sells smart hardware devices integrated with its AI and security technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on the dual pillars of 'AI + Security,' emphasizing AI-driven digital transformation and cybersecurity innovation. R&D priorities include advancing large-scale AI models, enhancing AI applications in internet products, and developing AI-powered security solutions. The company invests heavily in R&D (over 40% of revenue) to maintain leadership in AI and cybersecurity, with initiatives in enterprise AI solutions, digital security cloud services, and AI-enabled smart hardware.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: internet advertising and services, subscription-based internet value-added services, smart hardware sales, gaming-related revenues (net of developer shares), and sales of cybersecurity products and services. The company is transitioning from primarily advertising-based income to increased subscription and value-added service revenues, especially leveraging AI capabilities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's AI and cybersecurity sectors, recognized for its advanced AI models and comprehensive security solutions. It competes with other Chinese AI and cybersecurity firms, leveraging its large user base, proprietary technologies, and government-level cybersecurity capabilities. It holds a strong market position in PC security products and internet services with over 400 million monthly active users on PC platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.95 billion, a 12.23% decline year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.09 billion. Total assets stood at RMB 38.26 billion with equity of RMB 30.21 billion. Despite revenue decline, the company maintains substantial R&D investment and cash reserves (~RMB 25 billion) to support growth. The company faces challenges from market shifts but continues to invest in AI and security innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integration of cutting-edge AI technologies with cybersecurity expertise, offering AI-powered internet products and comprehensive digital security solutions. Its proprietary large language models and security big data capabilities enable real-time threat detection and response, providing a 'see and act' security approach. The company emphasizes 'security as a service' and AI-driven productivity enhancements, delivering unique value to both consumer and enterprise customers.
